trigger: A response with more than 5000 distinct facets silently lacks the cut values for the facet filter, group-from-results and the agent-count preview, which show exact answers
summary: A response with more than 5000 distinct facets silently lacks the cut values for the facet filter, group-from-results and the agent-count preview, which show exact answers. Before this change the cut set was an arbitrary hash-order subset; after it, it is deterministic and systematic. The reader-visibility gap itself is not introduced by this change.

Not fixable by a cheap in-PR change: readers need a per-response capped marker and to refuse or label a result built on a capped index (also ADR-1011 consumer work). Tracked in #5630 with the batch_failed alert; the residual is stated in the code comment and metrics.md. Adjudication note: the derived band is HIGH for the pre-existing class; this PR makes it deterministic and observable via the cap counter, and does not add a new reader-facing failure. Adjudicated by Fable (non-author) as pre-existing and tracked.
adjudication_rationale: Pre-existing, not introduced or worsened: the 5000 cap and the silent subset exist at the merge-base (response_store.cpp, #2691) and no reader or cap value changed. The old cut blacked out whole trailing columns in unordered_map bucket order and its 'same facets every time' comment was false; the new cut is value-granular, frequent-first, documented and counted (cap / value_too_long / batch_failed), and the loss magnitude strictly falls (one over-long value no longer drops every facet). Rare-value loss is now systematic and #5630 states that. Gate-7 constraint 1 bars only roadmap-parking; #5630 is an actionable P2 bug. A reader fix needs a per-response marker plus five dashboard sites, REST/MCP and an A4 lower-bound label: a separate review unit aligned with ADR-1011.

trigger: The facet-drop counters were incremented inside the transaction callback; when the SAVEPOINT or ROLLBACK TO machinery fails the whole response is rolled back, so batch_failed moved for a response that
summary: The facet-drop counters were incremented inside the transaction callback; when the SAVEPOINT or ROLLBACK TO machinery fails the whole response is rolled back, so batch_failed moved for a response that never persisted while HELP, the header and metrics.md said the response is stored in every case.

Deltas are accumulated locally and published only after with_txn_for succeeds; a failed SAVEPOINT, ROLLBACK TO or COMMIT publishes none; HELP, header and metrics.md say counters count stored responses only and that a SAVEPOINT-machinery failure is counted by ingest_dropped_total{query_error} alone. Verified by reading plus the unchanged suite (a SAVEPOINT failure cannot be forced in a test). The fix commit had no separate reviewer pass.

trigger: Facet values with an embedded NUL byte are truncated at bind and a plain twin in the same column collides on the primary key
summary: Facet values with an embedded NUL byte are truncated at bind and a plain twin in the same column collides on the primary key.

Refuted by Codex and checked: ResponseStore's own wrapper (response_store.cpp ~167-189) replaces every embedded NUL with U+FFFD before facet extraction (~506) and tests pin interior, leading, trailing and adjacent NULs, so neither the truncation nor the collision is reachable.
